content:
Hannah G: Quick thread: I'm assembling the relnotes for the docs release. Need three concise feature bullets, a Known Issues paragraph (ops asked for cold-start note), and verification that the SDK snippets still match the public API. Also request a short dev-facing example for the streaming change.

raj: I can run the Py/TS/Go snippets and update param names. Heads-up: `max_tokens` renamed in the SDK to `max_output_tokens` in the latest minor.

carmen: I'll add a short example showing explicit streaming usage and show both streaming and non-streaming payloads. Also found one migration page anchor that redirects to an old path.

Hannah G: Good. Include ops note: "First request after an idle period may see ~1s additional latency due to cache warm-up." Put that in Known Issues. Also call out: "Embedding score distributions may shift slightly after tokenizer patch; rebaseline thresholds if you use hard cutoffs."

l10n-bot: Reminder: any copy changes under /docs/relnotes/ require i18n keys. Please list changed keys in the PR description.

raj: Ran smoke tests locally. Py/TS work after swapping param names; Go needs a tiny struct rename. I'll open a single PR with all snippet patches and a checklist for l10n keys.

carmen: PR for example and anchor fix: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4981  includes streaming example with explicit `stream: true/false` variants and replaces the redirecting anchor with the new canonical path.

preview-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3456789012 (build #6).

Hannah G: Target: merge PRs by tomorrow 10am PT, then publish the relnotes. If localization hasn't finished, we'll ship EN-only and schedule localized follow-ups. Tag blockers here. Thanks!
